title: How long must an honest confidence interval be after causal discovery? Benign and malignant weak edges
abstract: arXiv:2611.30256v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: After causal discovery, a confidence interval for a total effect valid uniformly over the model class must pay for structural uncertainty. We measure this price by the worst-case ratio of expected length to that of the efficient interval knowing the graph, for linear Gaussian models with a known superset of the adjacencies and k-triangle faithfulness. The global price is of order sqrt(n) once one edge can be malignant, so we study it locally, near a generic distribution with one edge absent. Our main result classifies this weak edge by Meek closures. It is benign if deleting it leaves the effect identifiable in the resulting MPDAG and Markov equivalent explanations agree; the local price is then bounded, and otherwise, for small k, of order sqrt(n). At benign edges the price is of order R+K, with R a ratio of efficient lengths and K a cross-model constant. It equals one, so that honesty is free, exactly when K = 0, generically decided

translated_title: 因果发现之后，诚实的置信区间必须有多长？良性与恶性弱边
translated_abstract: 在因果发现之后，要在整个模型类上一致有效的总效应置信区间，必须为结构不确定性付出代价。我们以最坏情况下期望区间长度与已知图时有效区间长度之比来度量这一代价，研究对象为具有已知邻接关系超集和 k-三角忠实性假设的线性高斯模型。一旦存在一条可能“恶性”的边，全局代价便达到 √n 量级，因此我们在局部尺度上考察这一代价，即在一条边缺失的通用分布附近。我们的主要结果通过 Meek 闭包对这条弱边进行分类：若删除该边后，效应在所得的 MPDAG 中仍可识别，且各马尔可夫等价的解释彼此一致，则该边是“良性”的，此时局部代价有界；否则，当 k 较小时，代价为 √n 量级。在良性边处，代价为 R+K 的量级，其中 R 是有效长度的比值，K 是跨模型常数；当且仅当 K=0 时（这通常可由图结构判定），该代价等于 1，即“诚实性是免费的”。
tldr: 该论文通过 Meek 闭包将弱边分为“良性”与“恶性”两类，刻画了因果发现后诚实置信区间相对已知图最优区间的最坏长度膨胀代价：良性边处代价有界（当跨模型常数 K=0 时甚至等于 1，即诚实性免费），而一旦存在恶性边，代价便达到 √n 量级。
en_tdlr: The paper classifies weak edges as benign or malignant via Meek closures, characterizing how much longer an honest post-causal-discovery confidence interval must be than the oracle efficient interval: bounded at benign edges (even free, i.e., ratio one, when the cross-model constant K vanishes) but of order √n when an edge is malignant.
